- False-positive containment: Across the four frontier models, false-positive rates were 45–82.5%, while EGAR was only 37.5–54.2%, meaning most containment actions lacked preceding trusted evidence.

- Preliminary RL counter-finding: The trained model had 75% containment but 70% false positives and 47.5% correct containment; the authors conclude direct RL from the multi-component reward is insufficient.
